title: Fourier quasicrystals with positive integer masses are sections of Lee-Yang cycles
summary: We characterize Fourier quasicrystal measures with positive integer masses as real sections of effective Lee-Yang cycles, with weighted local intersection degrees. The section matrix has positive maximal minors, and the mass at each root is its weighted local intersection degree. For Delone support the reduced support of the cycle can be chosen strict. The support of every integer-mass Fourier quasicrystal measure is the common complex zero set of finitely many real-valued trigonometric polynomials.
